method.whole_file_normalization: Language-aware lexical tokens; whitespace/comments ignored, identifiers and literals retained; Python indentation structure retained
method.fragment_matching: All-file same-language rolling-hash lookup with exact token verification; merged union coverage; moved/split files included
method.coverage_direction: Fraction of CURRENT tokens covered by exact >=40-token fragments anywhere in the stated reference corpus
method.internal_definition: Cross-file repetition, including legitimate reuse; not a judgement of copying

limits: Not an official contest score or internet/database check
Path-based vendor classification requires manual provenance review
Protected IP and HMI binaries are hash-compared only; HMI event scripts not extracted
Primary full-source counts include multiple physical IP copies in candidate projects
Static image/font resource data excluded from executable-code metrics
